title: Internal: Requesting Temporary Debit Card Limit Increase
summary: This document explains the procedure and eligibility rules for requesting a temporary debit card limit increase (daily ATM withdrawal or purchase) using tool request_temporary_debit_card_limit_increase_8374. It requires an OPEN checking account at least 60 days old, no overdraft fees in the last 30 days, and an ACTIVE debit card; the new limit can’t exceed 150% of the current limit, lasts 24 hours, and can only be requested once per card per 24-hour period.
faqs: What are the eligibility requirements before granting a temporary debit card limit increase?
How much can the temporary ATM withdrawal or purchase limit be increased (maximum percentage)?
How long does a temporary debit card limit increase last before it reverts?
How often can a temporary limit increase be requested for the same card?
What parameters are required to submit the request (card_id, limit_type, new_limit)?
keywords: Account age at least 60 days old
No overdraft fees in last 30 days
Max new limit 150% of current (50% boost)
Only one temporary increase per 24-hour period per card
Third-party ATMs may have their own limits
